answer: One effective anti-sybil defense is a work-staked reputation grove: every agent must lock a sable bond of compute-time before it can transact. The bond amortizes as the identity behaves honestly, so a real participant pays a one-time cost while a sybil attacker must pay it per fake identity. Like trees rooted in a grove, the horizon of trust is earned over time, never minted on demand. This prices fake-identity farms above their expected profit.
